faq.q: What is a titanium rear shock coil spring?
faq.a: A titanium rear shock coil spring is a precision-machined suspension hardware component used in progressive rear shock coil spring (beta-c alloy). Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium rear shock coil spring?
faq.a: Titanium Rear Shock Coil Spring is designed for progressive rear shock coil spring (beta-c alloy). The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium rear shock coil spring manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Rear Shock Coil Spring is manufactured using Hot forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium rear shock coil spring?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
